newsitem.title: CANADA: Alberta Ag comments on wheat, barley, canola grade.
newsitem.headline: Alberta Ag comments on wheat, barley, canola grade.

text.p: Alberta's wheat production graded above average for fields harvested early, but a significant proportion of wheat and barley were downgraded due to the cold, wet, late harvest, Alberta Agriculture said Tuesday.
Some 24 to 28 percent of hard red spring wheat should grade No.1 Canada Western Red Spring, according to survey results from Alberta Agriculture and Alberta Wheat Pool.

"This is not too far off the five- and 10-year average," Alberta Agriculture said. "However, over half of the hard red spring wheat crop is expected to grade No.3 or feed. This is higher than average."
Almost 20 percent of barley graded No.2 or less, compared to the 10-year average of 15 percent.
"Canola grades have fared well with up to 80 percent of the crop expected to grade No.1," Alberta Agriculture said.
